projects.name: HouseCoin
projects.description: Development of a decentralized voting regulation system within residential areas, in order to prioritize fairness and transparency in collective decision making, generating a social impact with respect to the responsibility of a common good. Through a website implementing a smart contract (ERC-20) executed on the Avalanche blockchain.
highlights: Identify information on how the current voting system works through resident interview techniques and in turn validate the allocation of power according to the financial and social responsibility of the resident. And in this way structure the functional voting model for the resident area.

Design the architecture through the collected data and flow diagrams, defining the creation of tokens to be used generated by the smart contract (ERC-20) and distributed according to the resident's responsibility study, with this same contract the voting in the Avalanche Testnet Fuji will be regulated.

Develop the smart contract in the avalanche Testnet and define the infrastructure that will have in the Blockchain. Developing a user interface to manage the funds that were generated to be distributed through AirDrops to members, along with an AI Agent that will be integrated through n8n to the website and help residents with the process of creating walllets.

Implement a web application accessible and intuitive interface that will have as its core a smart contract, forming a decentralized platform, next to the multi-signature, and the liquidity pool, where the Token's will be stored, and the multi-signature that will be the platform where the people will be the ones in charge of approving the transactions of the Tokens to be made.
